        --primary-color: #3b82f6;      /* Blue 500 */
        --primary-color-hover: #2563eb; /* Blue 600 */
        --secondary-color: #f59e0b;     /* Amber 500 */
        --secondary-color-hover: #d97706;/* Amber 600 */
        --positive-color: #22c55e;      /* Green 500 */
        --positive-color-hover: #16a34a; /* Green 600 */
        --destructive-color: #ef4444;   /* Red 500 */
        --destructive-color-hover: #dc2626; /* Red 600 */
        
        --blue-600: #2563eb;
        --blue-800: #1e40af;
        --active-nav-text: #ffffff;
        --light-gray: #f8f9fa;
        --medium-gray: #e9ecef;
        --dark-gray: #6c757d;
        --text-color: #1f2937;         /* Slate 800 */
        --text-color-light: #6b7280;   /* Slate 500 */
        --white: #fff;
        --bg-color: #f1f5f9;           /* Slate 100 */
        --card-bg-color: #ffffff;
        --header-bg: #ffffff;
        --border-color: #e2e8f0;       /* Slate 200 */
        --shadow-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.06);

        /* VMT Theme Colors */
        --tesoros-color: #475569;        /* Slate 600 */
        --maestros-color: #d97706;       /* Amber 600 */
        --vida-cristiana-color: #be123c; /* Rose 700 */
        --no-corresponde-text: #b91c1c;   /* Red 700 */

        /* Component-specific Colors */
        --info-title-color: var(--primary-color);
        --whatsapp-color: #25D366;
        --success-bg: #dcfce7;
        --success-text: #166534;
        --error-bg: #fee2e2;
        --error-text: #991b1b;
        --info-bg: #eff6ff;
        --info-text: #1e40af;
        
        /* Spacing units */
        --space-sm: 0.5rem;
        --space-md: 1rem;
        --space-lg: 1.5rem;
    }

    .theme-dark {
        --primary-color: #60a5fa;      /* Blue 400 */
        --primary-color-hover: #3b82f6; /* Blue 500 */
        --secondary-color: #fbbf24;     /* Amber 400 */
        --secondary-color-hover: #f59e0b;/* Amber 500 */
        --positive-color: #4ade80;      /* Green 400 */
        --positive-color-hover: #22c55e; /* Green 500 */
        --destructive-color: #f87171;   /* Red 400 */
        --destructive-color-hover: #ef4444; /* Red 500 */

        --blue-600: #3b82f6;
        --blue-800: #60a5fa;
        --active-nav-text: #ffffff;
        --light-gray: #374151;         /* Slate 700 */
        --medium-gray: #1f2937;        /* Slate 800 */
        --dark-gray: #9ca3af;
        --text-color: #f1f5f9;         /* Slate 100 */
        --text-color-light: #9ca3af;   /* Slate 400 */
        --white: #111827;              /* Slate 900 */
        --bg-color: #0f172a;           /* Slate 950 */
        --card-bg-color: #1f2937;      /* Slate 800 */
        --header-bg: #1f2937;
        --border-color: #475569;       /* Slate 600 */
        --shadow-color: rgba(0,0,0,0.2);
        
        --tesoros-color: #94a3b8;        /* Slate 400 */
        --maestros-color: #fbbf24;       /* Amber 400 */
        --vida-cristiana-color: #f472b6; /* Rose 400 */
        --no-corresponde-text: #f87171;   /* Red 400 */

        --info-title-color: #60a5fa;
        --success-bg: #14532d;
        --success-text: #a7f3d0;
        --error-bg: #7f1d1d;
        --error-text: #fecaca;
        --info-bg: #1e3a8a;
        --info-text: #bfdbfe;
    }


    html { 
        scroll-behavior: smooth; 
    }

    body, .app-container { 
        font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Helvetica Neue", Arial, sans-serif; 
        line-height: 1.6; 
        margin: 0; 
        transition: background-color 0.3s, color 0.3s;
        background-color: var(--bg-color);
        color: var(--text-color);
        min-height: 100vh;
    }

    /* --- ESTILOS MODERNOS PARA GRUPO DE CONGREGACIÓN (FORCED COLORS) --- */
    .gc-header-title {
        font-size: 1.8rem;
        font-weight: 800;
        background: linear-gradient(135deg, #2563eb 0%, #4f46e5 100%);
        -webkit-background-clip: text;
        -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent;
        background-clip: text;
        color: #2563eb; /* Fallback */
        margin-bottom: 0.5rem;
    }

    .gc-card-add {
        background-color: #ffffff;
        border: 1px solid #e0e7ff;
        border-radius: 16px;
        padding: 1.5rem;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.1), 0 2px 4px -1px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.06);
        position: relative;
        overflow: hidden;
        margin-bottom: 2rem;
    }
    .gc-card-add::before {
        content: '';
        position: absolute;
        top: 0;
        left: 0;
        width: 6px;
        height: 100%;
        background-color: #4f46e5;
    }

    .gc-label-add {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.5rem;
        color: #3730a3;
        font-weight: 700;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        font-size: 0.85rem;
        letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        margin-bottom: 1rem;
    }

    .gc-input-add {
        width: 100%;
        padding: 0.75rem 1rem;
        padding-left: 2.5rem;
        border: 1px solid #d1d5db;
        border-radius: 0.75rem;
        font-size: 1rem;
        background-color: #f9fafb;
        transition: all 0.2s;
        box-sizing: border-box;
    }
    .gc-input-add:focus {
        background-color: #ffffff;
        border-color: #4f46e5;
        outline: none;
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.2);
    }

    .gc-btn-add {
        background-color: #4f46e5;
        color: white;
        font-weight: 600;
        padding: 0.75rem 2rem;
        border-radius: 0.75rem;
        border: none;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.2s;
        display: inline-flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.5rem;
        box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px rgba(79, 70, 229, 0.4);
    }
    .gc-btn-add:hover:not(:disabled) {
        background-color: #4338ca;
        transform: translateY(-1px);
    }
    .gc-btn-add:disabled {
        background-color: #a5a5a5;
        cursor: not-allowed;
        box-shadow: none;
    }

    .gc-table-header {
        background-color: #f8fafc;
        border-bottom: 1px solid #e2e8f0;
        color: #64748b;
        font-size: 0.75rem;
        text-transform: uppercase;
        letter-spacing: 0.05em;
        font-weight: 700;
        padding: 1rem;
    }

    /* Colores Específicos de Avatares */
    .avatar-red { background-color: #ef4444; color: white; }
    .avatar-orange { background-color: #f97316; color: white; }
    .avatar-amber { background-color: #f59e0b; color: white; }
    .avatar-green { background-color: #22c55e; color: white; }
    .avatar-teal { background-color: #14b8a6; color: white; }
    .avatar-blue { background-color: #3b82f6; color: white; }
    .avatar-indigo { background-color: #6366f1; color: white; }
    .avatar-purple { background-color: #a855f7; color: white; }
    .avatar-pink { background-color: #ec4899; color: white; }

    /* Estados de Input */
    .input-has-report {
        background-color: #ecfdf5 !important;
        border-color: #34d399 !important;
        color: #065f46 !important;
        font-weight: 700;
    }

    /* --- END ESTILOS GC --- */

    /* --- VIEW MODE VISIBILITY --- */
    .view-desktop .programa-mobile-view,
    .view-desktop .planificador-mobile-view,
    .view-desktop .filters-mobile-view,
    .view-desktop .assignment-mobile-view {
        display: none;
    }

    .view-mobile .programa-desktop-view,
    .view-mobile .planificador-desktop-view,
    .view-mobile .filters-desktop-view,
    .view-mobile .assignment-desktop-view {
        display: none;
    }


    /* --- PAGE TITLES --- */
    .page-title {
        font-size: 1.75rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-color);
        margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        padding-bottom: 0.75rem;
        border-bottom: 2px solid var(--primary-color);
    }

    /* --- LAYOUT & CONTAINERS --- */
    main {
        padding: var(--space-md);
    }
    @media (min-width: 768px) {
        main {
            padding: var(--space-lg);
        }
    }
    .container, .managers-container, .filters-container, .group-container {
        max-width: 1200px;
        margin: 0 auto;
        padding: 25px;
    }
    .planificador-page, .asignar-anc-min-page {
        padding: 0;
    }


    /* --- HEADER & NAVIGATION --- */
    .app-header {
        background-color: var(--header-bg);
        box-shadow: 0 1px 2px 0 var(--shadow-color);
        position: sticky;
        top: 0;
        z-index: 100;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
    }

    .app-header__container {
        max-width: 1200px;
        margin-left: auto;
        margin-right: auto;
        padding: var(--space-sm) var(--space-lg);
    }

    .app-header__inner {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
    }

    .app-header__branding {
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        gap: 0.75rem;
        color: inherit;
    }
    .app-header__logo .logo-shape { fill: var(--card-bg-color); stroke: var(--blue-800); }
    .app-header__logo .logo-divider { stroke: var(--blue-800); }
    .app-header__logo .logo-line-1 { stroke: var(--dark-gray); }
    .app-header__logo .logo-line-2 { stroke: var(--secondary-color); }
    .app-header__title {
        font-size: 1.25rem;
        font-weight: 700;
        color: var(--text-color);
        white-space: nowrap;
    }

    /* Desktop Navigation */
    .app-nav--desktop { display: none; }
    .app-header__desktop-actions { display: none; }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
        .app-nav--desktop { display: block; }
        .app-header__desktop-actions { display: flex; }
    }

    .app-nav__list { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: baseline; gap: 0.5rem 1rem; list-style: none; padding: 0; margin: 0; }
    .app-nav__button { transition: all 0.2s ease-in-out; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; color: var(--text-color-light); background-color: transparent; border: none; border-radius: 0.375rem; cursor: pointer; text-transform: capitalize; }
    .app-nav__button:hover { color: var(--primary-color); background-color: var(--light-gray); }
    .app-nav__button--active { background-color: var(--primary-color); color: var(--active-nav-text); box-shadow: 0 4px 6px -1px var(--shadow-color); }
    .app-nav__button--active:hover { color: var(--active-nav-text); background-color: var(--primary-color-hover); }

    /* Mobile Navigation Toggle */
    .app-nav__mobile-toggle-wrapper { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.5rem; }
    @media (min-width: 1024px) {
        .app-nav__mobile-toggle-wrapper { display: none; }
    }

    .app-nav__mobile-toggle { background-color: transparent; border: none; cursor: pointer; color: var(--dark-gray); padding: 0; }
    .app-nav__mobile-toggle:hover { color: var(--text-color); }
    .app-nav__mobile-toggle svg { height: 1.5rem; width: 1.5rem; fill: currentColor; }

    /* Header Action Buttons (Theme/View) */
    .app-header__actions { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.75rem; }
    .action-button { background: transparent; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); color: var(--text-color-light); width: 36px; height: 36px; border-radius: 50%; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; cursor: pointer; transition: all 0.2s; }
    .action-button:hover { background-color: var(--light-gray); color: var(--text-color); }

    /* Mobile Navigation Menu */
    .app-nav--mobile { margin-top: 1rem; }
    .app-nav__list--mobile { flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; align-items: stretch; }
    .app-nav--mobile .app-nav__button { width: 100%; text-align: left; padding: 0.75rem; }

    /* --- COMMON ELEMENTS & BUTTONS --- */
    .not-applicable, .not-applicable-2 { color: var(--no-corresponde-text); font-style: italic; font-size: 0.85em; text-align: center; display: block; padding: 8px 0; }

    button:hover:not(:disabled) {
        transform: translateY(-1px);
        box-shadow: 0 4px 12px var(--shadow-color);
    }
    button, .button {
        font-weight: 600;
        border-radius: 8px;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.2s ease;
        padding: 0.6rem 1.2rem;
        border: 1px solid transparent;
    }
    button:disabled {
        opacity: 0.6;
        cursor: not-allowed;
    }

    /* Primary Action Buttons */
    #save-changes-btn, .button-save, .accept-footer .save-all-btn, 
    .asignar-anc-min-page .page-header button, 
    .planificador-page .planificador-controls button,
    .send-link-button {
        background-color: var(--primary-color);
        color: var(--active-nav-text);
    }
    #save-changes-btn:hover:not(:disabled), .button-save:hover:not(:disabled), .accept-footer .save-all-btn:hover:not(:disabled),
    .asignar-anc-min-page .page-header button:hover:not(:disabled),
    .planificador-page .planificador-controls button:hover:not(:disabled),
    .send-link-button:hover:not(:disabled) {
        background-color: var(--primary-color-hover);
    }

    /* Secondary Action Buttons */
    .button-print, .download-button, .reports-filters .btn-print-pdf {
        background-color: var(--secondary-color);
        color: var(--active-nav-text);
        border-color: transparent;
    }
    .button-print:hover:not(:disabled), .download-button:hover:not(:disabled), .reports-filters .btn-print-pdf:hover:not(:disabled) {
        background-color: var(--secondary-color-hover);
    }

    /* Positive Action Buttons */
    .add-form .button {
        background-color: var(--positive-color);
        color: var(--active-nav-text);
    }
    .add-form .button:hover:not(:disabled) {
        background-color: var(--positive-color-hover);
    }

    /* Destructive Action Buttons */
    .delete-btn {
        background-color: var(--destructive-color);
        color: var(--active-nav-text);
        border: none;
    }
    .delete-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
        background-color: var(--destructive-color-hover);
    }

    /* Edit/Other Buttons */
    .edit-btn {
        background-color: var(--secondary-color);
        color: var(--active-nav-text);
        border: none;
    }
    .edit-btn:hover:not(:disabled) {
        background-color: var(--secondary-color-hover);
    }
    .btn-clear-filters, .btn-clear-filters-mobile {
        background-color: transparent;
        border: 1px solid var(--dark-gray);
        color: var(--dark-gray);
    }
    .btn-clear-filters:hover, .btn-clear-filters-mobile:hover {
        background-color: var(--dark-gray);
        color: var(--card-bg-color);
    }


    /* --- GESTIONAR PARTICIPANTES (NEW STYLES) --- */
    .managers-container, .group-container { 
        padding: 16px; 
        background: var(--card-bg-color); 
        border-radius: 10px; 
        box-shadow: 0 6px 20px var(--shadow-color); 
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color); 
    }

    .sub-nav-menu { 
        display: flex; 
        flex-wrap: wrap; 
        gap: 10px; 
        margin-bottom: 25px; 
        padding-bottom: 15px; 
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color); 
    }

    .sub-nav-button { 
        padding: 8px 12px; 
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color); 
        background-color: var(--light-gray); 
        color: var(--text-color-light); 
        cursor: pointer; 
        border-radius: 8px; 
        font-size: .9em; 
        font-weight: 500; 
        transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }

    .sub-nav-button:hover {
        background-color: var(--medium-gray);
        color: var(--text-color);
    }

    .sub-nav-button.active { 
        background-color: var(--primary-color); 
        color: var(--active-nav-text); 
        border-color: var(--primary-color);
        transform: translateY(-2px);
        box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.1);
    }

    .manager-panel {
        padding-top: 1.5rem;
    }

    .add-form { 
        display: flex; 
        gap: 10px; 
        margin-bottom: 10px; 
    }

    .add-form input { 
        flex-grow: 1; 
        padding: 10px; 
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color); 
        border-radius: 8px; 
        background-color: var(--bg-color); 
        color: var(--text-color); 
    }

    .search-and-status {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
        gap: 1rem;
        flex-wrap: wrap;
    }
    .search-box {
        position: relative;
        flex-grow: 1;
        max-width: 400px;
    }
    .search-input {
        width: 100%;
        box-sizing: border-box;
        padding: 0.75rem 1rem 0.75rem 2.5rem;
        border-radius: 2rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        background-color: var(--bg-color);
        color: var(--text-color);
        font-size: 1rem;
        transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .search-input:focus {
        outline: none;
        border-color: var(--primary-color);
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-color) 20%, transparent);
    }
    .search-icon {
        position: absolute;
        left: 1rem;
        top: 50%;
        transform: translateY(-50%);
        color: var(--text-color-light);
    }
    .status-message {
        font-weight: 500;
        color: var(--text-color-light);
        height: 1.5rem;
        text-align: right;
        flex-shrink: 0;
    }

    .participant-list {
        list-style: none;
        padding: 0;
        margin: 0;
    }
    .participant-item, .list-item-placeholder {
        display: flex;
        justify-content: space-between;
        align-items: center;
        padding: 1rem;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        transition: background-color 0.2s ease;
    }
    .participant-list li:last-child {
        border-bottom: none;
    }
    .participant-item:hover {
        background-color: var(--light-gray);
    }
    .list-item-placeholder {
        justify-content: center;
        color: var(--text-color-light);
        font-style: italic;
    }
    .participant-name {
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        color: var(--text-color);
        flex-grow: 1;
    }

    .actions {
        display: flex;
        gap: 0.75rem;
    }
    .action-btn {
        width: 36px;
        height: 36px;
        border-radius: 50%;
        border: none;
        background-color: transparent;
        color: var(--text-color-light);
        cursor: pointer;
        display: flex;
        align-items: center;
        justify-content: center;
        transition: all 0.2s ease;
    }
    .action-btn i {
        font-size: 1rem;
    }
    .action-btn:hover {
        background-color: var(--medium-gray);
        transform: scale(1.1);
    }
    .action-btn.edit-btn:hover { color: var(--secondary-color); }
    .action-btn.delete-btn:hover { color: var(--destructive-color); }
    .action-btn.save-btn { color: var(--positive-color); }
    .action-btn.save-btn:hover { background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--positive-color) 15%, transparent); }
    .action-btn.cancel-btn { color: var(--dark-gray); }
    .action-btn.cancel-btn:hover { background-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--dark-gray) 15%, transparent); }

    .edit-input {
        flex-grow: 1;
        font-size: 1rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        padding: 0.5rem;
        border: 1px solid var(--primary-color);
        border-radius: 6px;
        background-color: var(--card-bg-color);
        color: var(--text-color);
    }
    .edit-input:focus {
        outline: none;
        box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in srgb, var(--primary-color) 20%, transparent);
    }
    @media (max-width: 600px) { 
        .participant-item { flex-direction: column; align-items: flex-start; gap: 10px; } 
        .search-and-status {
            flex-direction: column;
            align-items: stretch;
        }
        .status-message {
            text-align: left;
        }
    }


    /* --- FILTROS AVANZADOS --- */
    .filters-tabs-nav {
        display: flex;
        gap: 0.5rem;
        border-bottom: 1px solid var(--border-color);
        margin-bottom: 1.5rem;
    }
    .filters-tabs-nav .tab-button {
        padding: 0.75rem 1.25rem;
        font-weight: 500;
        color: var(--text-color-light);
        background-color: transparent;
        border: none;
        border-bottom: 3px solid transparent;
        cursor: pointer;
        transition: all 0.2s;
    }
    .filters-tabs-nav .tab-button:hover {
        color: var(--primary-color);
    }
    .filters-tabs-nav .tab-button.active {
        color: var(--primary-color);
        border-bottom-color: var(--primary-color);
        font-weight: 600;
    }
    .filter-buttons { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 8px; }
    .filter-btn { padding: 8px 15px; border: 1px solid var(--border-color); background-color: var(--light-gray); color: var(--text-color-light); cursor: pointer; border-radius: 20px; font-size: .9em; }
    .filter-btn.active { background-color: var(--secondary-color); color: #fff; border-color: transparent; font-weight: 700; }
    .table-wrapper { width: 100%; overflow-x: auto; }
    .filters-table { width: 100%; border-collapse: collapse; font-size: .9em; min-width: 800px; }
    .filters-table th, .filters-table td { border: 1px solid var(--border-color); padding: 8px; text-align: center; }
    .filters-table th { background-color: var(--light-gray); position: sticky; top: 0; z-index: 2; }
    .filters-table td:first-child, .filters-table th:first-child { text-align: left; font-weight: 700; position: sticky; left: 0; background-color: var(--card-bg-color); z-index: 1; min-width: 150px; }
    .filters-legend { font-size: 0.8rem; }
    .assignment-marker { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 8px; border-radius: 4px; font-weight: 700; font-size: .9em; line-height: 1.2; border: 1px solid rgba(0,0,0,.1); }
    .participant-card__header { background-color: var(--tesoros-color); color: #fff; }

    /* Mobile View for Filtros Avanzados */
    .mobile-filter-panel { background-color: var(--card-bg-color); border: 1px solid var(--border-color); border-radius: 12px; padding: 1.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 4px 12px var(--shadow-color); }
    .filter-group { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 0.5rem; }
